test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Raju travels 150 km in 7.5 hours moving downstream. The speed of the stream is 5 km/h. Find the speed with which Raju should row the boat to reach back in the same time.
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 150 km

Time = 7.5 hours

Speed of the stream = 5 km/h

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/time

Downstream = u + v

Upstream = u - v

u = speed of the boat in still water

v = speed of the stream

**Calculation:**

Downstream speed of the boat = 150/7.5
